sections.title: Natural products, *chosen for quality*
sections.intro: We're an old-fashioned brick-and-mortar store and don't sell online, because the better we know you, the more we can help. Can't come in? Call, and we'll set your order aside for curbside pickup.

items.title: Supplements & vitamins
items.text: Proven brands with quality ingredients, and staff who can help you sort through them.

items.title: Herbal remedies
items.text: Herbs, tinctures, healing clay, sage, honey soap and other natural staples.

items.title: Natural pet food
items.text: American-made foods and treats whenever possible, chosen with input from local veterinarians.

items.title: Pet supplements
items.text: Natural remedies and supplements for dogs and cats.

items.title: Free food samples
items.text: Picky dog? Cats eat for shape and texture. Try samples before you commit to a bag.

items.title: Curbside pickup
items.text: Call ahead to check availability and we'll bring it out to you.

sections.title: Massage, *your way*
sections.intro: State-licensed therapists work in six private massage rooms in a regularly inspected facility. Sessions run 30, 60 or 90 minutes depending on the massage; tell your therapist where you hold tension and the pressure you like.

items.name: Deep tissue massage
items.desc: Slower, firmer work that realigns connective and muscle tissue.

items.name: Therapeutic massage
items.desc: Focused work on problem areas, from stress relief to chronic pain.

items.name: Hot stone massage
items.desc: Warm stones add deep heat and relaxation.

items.name: Couples massage
items.desc: Two therapists, one large room, side by side with your partner.

sections.footnote: Ask your therapist about lengths and pricing. Gift certificates are available from each therapist.

sections.title: Call or text *your therapist*
sections.intro: Each practitioner keeps their own schedule, so book with them directly.

sections.title: Every one of us *has pets at home*
sections.intro: Our staff use natural products for their own families, people and animals alike, and that's the experience we bring to the counter.

sections.title: From 750 square feet *to a wellness destination*
body: Jeri Barrett opened Herbal Solutions in 1998 as a 750-square-foot shop in Centre South Plaza, focused on natural products for people and their pets. The store has since more than tripled in size, to over 3,200 square feet, and added professional massage and a dedicated pet health section.
"I'm still excited to come to work every day, even after all these years," says Jeri. "I help people and their pets find better health through natural methods."

items.text: I love this little store. They're always helpful and carry many products I can't find anywhere else. They're reasonable too. They have free samples that are very helpful.
The absolute best place for you and your four-legged companions! I buy all of my dogs' food and treats and supplements here. The staff goes above and beyond every single visit!
Great therapists, great natural dog products, and nice and generous staff and owner!

items.q: Which massage should I choose to relax?
items.a: Swedish massage is the classic relaxation option, and hot stone adds warmth. Your therapist can help you decide.
Yes. Every massage is given by a South Carolina state-licensed therapist, and the spa is inspected every year.

items.q: Can I buy a massage gift certificate?
items.a: Yes. Contact your preferred therapist directly to arrange one.

items.q: Do you ship or sell online?
items.a: No. We're a brick-and-mortar store, but call us and we'll check availability and set up curbside pickup.
We're at 722 Silver Bluff Road in Centre South Plaza, with parking right outside.

sections.title: Not sure where to start?
sections.text: Stop by and ask. We'll help you find what works for you, or for the dog waiting in the car.
